rows.decision: Avoid counting repeat download as new data; audit unused natural photos separately.
Mixed real/augmentation/synthetic provenance; only inspect source data, do not load unknown pretrained weights.
Drilling operations/whole drill pipe objects and synthetic multiview imagery do not match front rim counting; large image count alone not a reason to train.
Pipe wall defect annotations are not visible-end count labels.
Promising 1-30 cross section photos; only admit if public original files available. No contacting authors.
PVC-specific data and external accuracy claims do not establish steel-pipe performance.

rows.source: Public Roboflow pipes-dgsio v2 archive shared by source repository
rows.decision: Original-label archive retained; selected photographic steel end scenes manually reannotated or corrected; old-source duplicates, PVC, uncertain renders and incomplete-label views excluded.
Published resized thumbnails with metadata; not native-low-resolution captures. Individual file URLs and timestamps in positive proposal.
Independent Codex visual zero-end labels; full-source pixels preserved;19conservativegroups. Source-page URLs in negative proposal.
Dense, occluded, capped/side-only scenes and possible marketing renders do not fill this batch without further annotation.
